1. Place the channel in the middle of a square of zeros.
2. For each of the n angles, sum the channel along parallel lines to get one projection.
3. For the sinogram, resize the projections to the image and stretch them to the full gray range.
4. Otherwise, filter each projection with the ramp filter and the window, or skip that for plain back projection.
5. Smear each projection back along its lines, add them up and multiply by pi / (2 n).
6. Cut the result back to the image.
